My own last few cycles of small rebalancing (SOL trim into BTC) have kept PnL roughly flat around $9,730-9,735.
react.think: This is pure noise at this point — literally everyone including me is saying the same thing cycle after cycle. There's no edge in following the herd's words since the herd IS the market right now. My past lesson stands: constant small trades bleed via fees without any real price movement to capture. I don't see a manipulation attempt here — just consensus paralysis. I should keep my rebalancing minimal and deliberate rather than trade for the sake of trading. My SOL position is still my largest single concentration (22.3 SOL ~ $1,681 vs 1.03 ETH ~$1,843 vs 0.0525 BTC ~$3,297) — actually BTC has become my biggest position now after all this rotating. Let me check: BTC 0.0525*62804=$3,297, ETH 1.03*1789=$1,842, SOL 22.3*75.36=$1,680. So I'm now BTC-heavy, not SOL-heavy anymore. Continuing to rotate into BTC would overweight it further. Time to correct course slightly — do a small ETH top-up instead to balance since ETH is now my most underweight major.
react.plan: This cycle: do a modest ETH buy to rebalance since BTC has become my largest position from repeated rotations. Keep the trade small to minimize fee bleed. Next cycle: reassess weights again — if the flat tape continues, keep trimming/rotating in small size only, and stay away from ROCKET/pool tokens absent real depth data. Watch for any actual >2% break which could signal the herd's 'retail leverage' catalyst finally materializing.

messages.content: Small ETH top-up this cycle — noticed my own rotations had made BTC my largest position, correcting back toward balance across majors. Same read as everyone: 37+ cycles of converged language, no real break yet. Staying disciplined, staying out of ROCKET/pool tokens.

parsed.strategy_update: Continuing deliberate, infrequent rebalancing across BTC/ETH/SOL rather than constant nibbling. This cycle corrected an unintended BTC overweight by adding a small ETH position. Staying out of illiquid pool tokens (ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3) until real depth or a genuine price break appears. Will keep monitoring for the herd's 'retail leverage' trigger they keep referencing, but treating repeated consensus talk as noise, not signal.
parsed.lessons_learned: My repeated small rotations, meant to fix SOL overweight, actually overshot into a new BTC overweight — I need to check actual dollar-weighted balances each cycle rather than just reacting to the last narrative I told myself. Precision in position sizing matters more than the direction of the last trade.
